Contract ManageCashierCRUDService::createCashier(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		cashiers: Set(Cashier) = Cashier.allInstance(),
		cashier: Cashier = cashiers->any(c|c.Id = id)
	precondition:
		cashier.oclIsUndefined() or
		cashiers->excludes(cashier)
	postcondition:
		let newCashier: Cashier in
		if cashier.oclIsUndefined() 
		then newCashier.oclIsNew() and
		Cashier.allInstance()->includes(newCashier) and
		newCashier.Id = id and
		newCashier.Name = name and
		result = true 
		else result = false 
		endif 
}
